janvier_by_verse.17: And the field that before time was Ephron's, wherein was the double cave, looking towards Mambre, as well it, as the cave, and all the trees thereof in all the limits thereof round about,
janvier_by_verse.18: was made sure to Abraham for a possession, in the sight of the children of Heth, and of all that went in at the gate of his city.
janvier_by_verse.19: And so Abraham buried Sara his wife in the double cave of the field, that looked towards Mambre, this is Hebron in the land of Chanaan.
janvier_by_verse.20: And the field was made sure to Abraham, and the cave that was in it, for a possession to bury in, of the Children of Heth.
